labels: [obs] measured from pixels; [fit] model fitted to measurements; [inf] inference; [asm] assumption

camera_drift.verdict: [obs] NOT static: smooth push-in, image scale +4.76 % over 10 s (0.481 %/s, near-linear) about (973, 512) px, pan tx -46.4 px / ty -24.7 px, roll < 0.059 deg
camera_drift.method: 8-dof ECC homography of every frame vs frame 0 on a static mask (KLT-chain init); per-frame similarity extracted

evidence.static_landmark_track_vs_homography_rms_: 0.25-0.73 for the 8 top-frame landmarks (static_landmarks.csv); post-bottom/plate landmarks 0.7-2.1

camera_drift.zoom_vs_dolly: frame and side table give the same scale within 0.3 %; backdrop textureless (inconclusive). Modelled as zoom (clip-01 precedent); dolly not excluded

weight.methods: B silhouette profiles + Tukey line fits (primary); C Canny + RANSAC lines (check); A photometric ECC affine kept as diagnostic (fails: highlights do not move with the body)
weight.note: B-C differences are swing-correlated (systematic ~2-4 px, ~2 deg), i.e. silhouette definition depends on motion blur/background; treat weight centre to +-3 px and tilt to +-2 deg (static offset +-1.8 deg)

ring.methods: A radial edges + robust circle fit (primary); B annulus ZNCC (check)
ring.note: eye-ring centre = spring lower attachment; most precise moving observable; single-frame outlier at frame 116 (method A radius -3 px)

spring.methods: row-extent midpoint line fit (primary) vs gradient-centroid line fit (check)
spring.top_attachment: S-hook static to 0.64 px rms (max 1.15) after drift removal: the hook does NOT move

three_d.assumption: ring, weight centre and spring axis in the vertical plane Y=0 through A (frame-front-parallel)
three_d.verdict: [obs/inf] no consistent out-of-plane motion: weight-width depth cue gives swing-plane yaw -14 +- 3 deg, ring-radius cue 10 +- 4 deg (opposite signs -> systematics dominate); quadrature (elliptical) terms consistent with 0. Plane Y=0 adopted; |yaw| <~ 15 deg not excluded

lateral_swing.phase_t0: phase at t=0: weight essentially at its left turning point (swing -7.27 deg at t=0, turning point at t=0.047 s, -7.48 deg); not released exactly at t=0

vertical_bob.verdict: [obs] no independent axial (bob) oscillation: pivot-ring distance varies only +-1.2 px rms about 546 px, explained by swing-locked w and 2w terms (spectral peaks 0.767 and 1.533 Hz); residual after regression on phi, phi^2, phidot^2 is 0.97 px rms with remaining power at the swing frequency only. The prompt's 1 cm vertical bob is absent.

weight_rocking.verdict: [obs] the weight tilts in phase with the swing, ~1.3-1.4x the swing angle (i.e. it rocks ~2.5-3 deg beyond the pivot-ring line): consistent with the in-phase mode of a double pendulum (spring + weight hinged at the ring) [inf]

spring_axis.note: spring axis tilt ~0.96x the P_eff-ring angle; the spring body pivots about its top coil (P_eff), the S-hook is fixed

modes.spin: [obs] not measurable: brushed axisymmetric cylinder; photometric ECC shows highlight bands do not follow the body (view-dependent reflections)
modes.frequency_ratio: undefined: no independent axial frequency observed (only swing harmonics); autoparametric 2:1 not testable from the reference

cadence.verdict: [obs] same generator 4-frame cadence as clip 01: steps into n = 0 mod 4 are ~1.67x; diagnostic only, not a retiming licence

discontinuities.attachment_jump: none: S-hook static to <=1.2 px after drift removal; ring and weight tracks have no acceleration outliers > 6 robust sigma (ring/weight centre screens 0 flagged)
discontinuities.coil_count_change: none: open-coil gap count is 11 or 12; the 12th gap is the boundary turn between the open and close-wound sections and appears only when the spring is swung to image-right (mean swing +6.3 deg vs -2.2 deg), reversibly, 16 transitions; the close-wound section keeps ~10 scallops (right edge median). Interpreted as a near-closed coil opening on the outside of the bend, not a coil-count change
discontinuities.shape_change: none visible: single-frame tracker outliers at frame 116 (ring radius -3 px, method A vs B differ by 5 px; ring looks unchanged in a 2x zoom) and weight width/tilt outliers at frames 75-77, 135-136, 143-144 coincide with motion blur/cadence frames; weight silhouette length is constant (sd 0.8 px)

anchor_window.reason: no qualifying amplitude increase (> 3 sigma) in any measured mode and no visible discontinuity

near_misses.mode: lateral swing (image angle of ring about P_eff)
weight rocking (absolute weight tilt at swing turning points)
weight rocking relative to pivot-ring line

anchor_window.literal_radius_note: if the rule were applied literally to the raw r(t) turning points (not an oscillation mode), the first > 3 sigma increase would be at t = 9.373291 s

trends_not_tested_by_rule.note: the declared rule tests half-cycle-to-half-cycle jumps only; the swing amplitude instead grows gradually (+4.5 % from 0.98 s to 4.19 s, a non-physical energy injection for a passive system) and then decays faster; the half-period lengthens by 7.5 % over the clip. Both lie inside a 10 s anchor window.

ai_defects_vs_prompt: lateral swing +-8 deg (image) with weight rocking (prompt: straight vertical bob, no sideways motion)
no visible vertical bob (prompt: ~1 cm bob, decaying)
swing amplitude grows +4.5 % over 1-4 s then decays (non-physical energy injection)
half-period lengthens 7.5 % over the clip (period wander)
camera push-in +4.8 % and pan (prompt: frame perfectly still / locked camera)
S-hook static while the spring body pivots at its top coil (hook should swing with the spring if hinged at the bar)
